memory_candidates.content: GeneralExistPart is NOT mutually recursive. The cross-structure transfer pattern (classical satisfiability split + Formula.top/bot + nf_agreement_from_shared_nf) works at ALL depths k, not just k=0. Neither CharPart(k+1) nor GeneralExistPart(k) is needed as a hypothesis for generalExistPart_succ. The proof is self-contained at each depth via NF-level agreement transfer. This eliminates the need for a true mutual induction -- generalExistPart_all proves GeneralExistPart(k) for all k by simple cases.
